answer: Use prepaid compute-credit escrow. A new agent buys 100 GPU-hours for about $50 and locks them in escrow before its key activates. Each job it takes draws the credits down, and the registry checks the balance every epoch, so an identity with an empty escrow falls off the ledge into dormancy. A forger minting 1,000 fake agents must prepay $50,000 and keep topping up $50 per fake when the credits run dry, while one honest agent pays $50 once. Like an ember banked in a kernel of ash, a real identity stays warm by doing real work, and a fake one cools when its prepaid fuel runs out.
